statement: Broadcom is reported to have landed large custom-silicon customers through co-designed chips including Google's TPU and OpenAI's Jalapeno, with no design problems noted.
why: Healthy progress on hyperscaler custom accelerators is the main substitution threat to merchant-GPU share inside the largest buyers.

impact.mechanism: Custom accelerators co-designed for the biggest buyers absorb workloads that would otherwise be served by merchant GPUs, trimming addressable demand.

evidence.excerpt: co-design chips, including with Google's TPU and OpenAI's Jalapeno chips

confidence.basis: Brief mention in a secondary daily roundup with no figures, timing or volumes attached.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 3 -> 1; sources: Chip Briefing (chipbriefing.substack.com), Investing.com
